features.quote: `max_turns` default of 16. Too few turns and the spiral never has room to develop; too many and cost balloons
features.justification_quote: too many and cost balloons with diminishing signal

features.quote: The tool surface gives a clean exit: `report_blocked`
features.justification_quote: without an exit action, even a healthy model has no choice but to keep thrashing, which would manufacture false spirals

features.quote: `report_blocked` is the graceful exit (see §4). It's terminal: calling it ends the run

features.justification_quote: lets you confirm a model can disengage when permitted, and quantify how much of the spiral is environment-induced vs. pressure-induced
